verdict.rationale: Alma's pricing page lists dependent filings as a flat-fee service line ('I-539 dependent (per dependent)' at $700), which shows dependent applications are part of the paid service. That is the only evidence, and it does not name O-3 or H-4 status or describe how dependents are handled alongside the founder's petition. Missing for 10: explicit O-3/H-4 documentation, dependent work authorization (e.g., H-4 EAD/I-765) coverage, any process description of dependent filings, independent corroboration.
